title: Paul McCartney live: Arrowhead Pond, Anaheim | 2002
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Arrowhead Pond in Anaheim, California, USA, on 25 October 2002.

It was the 47th date of the Driving World Tour, which lasted for 58 dates across four countries between April and November 2002. This show was seen by 13,588 fans.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

The Driving World Tour previously called at the Arrowhead Pond on 5 May 2002. McCartney also performed there on 11 and 12 November 2005 during the US Tour.
